## Purpose
Industry knowledge entries filed against domain concepts. It covers list, search, create, delete, a retrieval rehearsal, and attaching the knowledge tool to agents.

## Responsibilities
- `KnowledgeTab`:
- - `ontologyApi.knowledge` and `knowledgeSearch`;
- - `EntryCard`;
- - `CreateEntryDialog` (`createKnowledge`, "Knowledge entry saved.");
- - `deleteKnowledge` ("Entry deleted."), single or bulk;
- - `RehearsalPanel`;
- - `attachKnowledgeTool` (`/api/rag/agents/sync`).
